<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The tour skip state needs to be saved to localStorage.

A localStorage key will track completion state. The tour opens only if localStorage shows it was never skipped. Replaying the tour may clear or preserve that flag. Next.js SSR hydration needs careful handling.

Starting the tour open would flash it briefly during SSR. The component should initialize closed and read localStorage in useEffect to avoid that. Another option is a lazy initializer that checks localStorage directly.
</details></think>
